Не смотря на то, что процессы испускания: Although the processes of photon emission and absorption by atoms and nuclei are strictly described only within quantum theory, many aspects of these phenomena can be qualitatively explained within classical physics. Each atom has a set of natural frequencies and therefore emits electromagnetic waves with a strictly defined set of frequencies (in the infrared, visible, and ultraviolet ranges). When atoms absorb light, they absorb radiation only at frequencies close to their natural oscillation frequencies, similar to traditional resonance in classical systems. A similar situation occurs with atomic nuclei emission — only the energy of these quanta lies in the gamma radiation range (therefore, in this range, energy quanta are discussed rather than frequencies or wavelengths).
